summary: Tested Quick Connect deep link feature for Remote Sessions page. All 8 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - setup button, modal, form inputs, save functionality, connect button with label, settings gear, and modal pre-fill all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints correctly require admin authentication (401/403 without token)
POST endpoint properly strips whitespace from label and address
POST endpoint filters out entries with empty anydesk_address
Frontend correctly shows 'Set Up Quick Connect' button when no address is saved
Frontend correctly shows 'Connect to [label]' button after address is saved
Settings gear button correctly opens modal pre-filled with saved values
The anydesk: URI scheme deep link cannot be fully tested in headless browser but button presence and click handler verified
seed_data_creation: Test host address created and cleared during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick Connect feature tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/remote-sessions/host-addresses (admin auth required, returns {addresses: []}), POST /api/remote-sessions/host-addresses (admin auth required, accepts array of {label, anydesk_address}, returns {success: true, addresses: [...]}). Frontend: Remote Sessions page at /remote-sessions shows 'Set Up Quick Connect' button (data-testid='setup-connect-btn') when no address saved, shows 'Connect to [label]' button (data-testid='connect-anydesk-btn') when address saved, settings gear (data-testid='edit-connect-btn') opens modal pre-filled with saved values. Modal has data-testid='connect-setup-modal' with inputs data-testid='connect-address-input' and data-testid='connect-label-input'. The connect button uses window.open('anydesk:ADDRESS', '_self') which opens AnyDesk native app - cannot be tested in headless browser.
